```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```
##CCVs:
```{r}
breedSiteLocations = read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breedSiteLocations)
colnames(breedSiteLocations)
glimpse(breedSiteLocations)

selectedSites = breedSiteLocations |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct()
gt(selectedSites)

migrationSites = read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migrationSites))

```

```{r}
myNums |> sum()

```
##copied code chunk:
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected = breedSiteLocations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

migrationSiteSelected = migrationSites |> 
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

birdSiteEdited = bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
migrationSiteEdited = migrationSiteSelected |> filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
gt(birdSiteEdited)

bird_migration_grouped <- migrationSiteEdited |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)

bird_migration_grouped <- migrationSiteEdited |> group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_summary)

```
